answer: Layered bonds stop hollow identities. A newcomer posts 75 credits: 30 to enter, a 20-credit velvet layer absorbing one failed check, and 25 unlocking only after verified jobs. A hollow shell with no real work stalls. A garden of auditors checks layers apart, so the bribery trap fails: one auditor passes one layer. 1,000 fakes lock 75,000 credits plus 15,000 fees vs a 40,000 pool: a certain loss. An honest agent pays 75 once and earns it back.
